name: Account Password Reset
description: Sent when a user requests a password reset via email.
subject: #if (${sourcename})${sourcename} – Account Password Reset#{else}${PRODUCT_NAME} – Password Reset#end
body:
Account Password Reset

Dear ${user.name},

#if (${sourcename})

We received a request to reset the password for your ${sourcename} account. If you made this request, please verify your identity and set a new password.

#{else}

We received a request to reset your ${PRODUCT_NAME} password. If you made this request, please verify your identity and set a new password.

#end

If the link does not work, copy and paste the following URL into your browser:

${verificationURL}

If you did not make this request, contact your IT administrator immediately.

Thank you for using ${PRODUCT_NAME}.
